name: SkillPulse LMS
author: Hardip Parmar

sections.description:
SkillPulse LMS is a Learning Management System (LMS) plugin for WordPress that helps educators, trainers, coaches, and organizations create and manage online learning experiences.

Whether you’re offering a single course or building a complete learning platform, SkillPulse LMS provides the tools needed to create courses, lessons, quizzes, and track learner progress.

Features

Course Management

  • Create unlimited courses
  • Organize courses using categories and tags
  • Add featured images and course descriptions
  • Structure courses with sections and lessons

Lesson Management

  • Rich text lesson editor
  • Video lesson support
  • Lesson completion tracking
  • Responsive lesson layouts

Quiz System

  • Multiple-choice quizzes
  • Student quiz attempts
  • Basic grading functionality
  • Quiz performance tracking

Student Experience

  • Student dashboard
  • Course enrollment system
  • Progress tracking
  • Certificate generation

Administration

  • Modern React-powered admin interface
  • Course builder tools
  • Responsive design
  • Easy-to-use management screens

Premium Features

A premium version of SkillPulse LMS is available and includes additional functionality such as:

  • Payment gateway integrations
  • Advanced lesson types
  • Additional quiz types and settings
  • Drip content scheduling
  • Course prerequisites
  • Email automation
  • Membership integrations
  • Advanced reporting
  • Custom certificate templates
  • Instructor management tools

More information is available at:
https://skillpulselms.com/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/skillpulse-lms/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to SkillPulse LMS in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create your first course and start building your learning platform.
sections.faq:
Is SkillPulse LMS free?

Yes. The free version includes core LMS functionality for creating courses, lessons, quizzes, and tracking student progress.

Can I create unlimited courses?

Yes. There are no limits on the number of courses or lessons you can create.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes. Existing course content and settings remain intact when upgrading to a premium version.

Does the plugin support video lessons?

Yes. Video lessons are supported.

Where can I get support?

Support is available through the WordPress.org support forums.
